operator.name: Northbank Rail
operator.disclaimer: Northbank Rail is a fictional train operating company. All figures in this dataset are synthetic and generated for demonstration purposes.

seatsense.measures: Per-seat occupancy - whether a seat is physically occupied by a person, reported continuously per coach.

pilot.scope: 3 units on the Anglia Metro (NBR1), 24 coaches instrumented
findings: On departures sold at 100% or more of seated capacity, an average of 11.2% of seats travelled empty.
Median 54 paid-but-empty seats per peak departure; worst observed 81 seats.
Ticket sales overstated the number of people on board peak trains by 9-12%.
Sales caps were being applied to trains that had seats available the whole journey.

demand_classes.label: Morning peak core
demand_classes.description: The 07:00-08:30 arrivals. Sold out, capped, standing passengers.

demand_classes.label: Peak shoulder
demand_classes.description: The half-empty departures either side of the crush - the demo's real prize.

demand_classes.label: Off-peak
demand_classes.description: Midday and late evening leisure travel.

demand_classes.label: Evening peak
demand_classes.description: The 16:30-18:00 exodus out of the city.

demand_classes.label: Early / late
demand_classes.description: First and last departures of the day.

what_2025_had: Tickets sold per departure, and the revenue from them.
Gateline entries and exits at staffed stations - a station total, not a seat.
Manual load surveys: a counter with a clicker on a handful of days a year.
Whether sales were closed on a departure, and at what threshold.
what_2025_could_not_have: How many people were actually on board - a no-show is invisible to ticket data.
Whether a seat was occupied, reserved-and-empty, or holding a bag.
The cabin factor of any given departure on any given day.
Therefore: whether closing sales on a departure was justified.
ticket_data.reported_metric_2025: assumed_load_factor_pct = tickets sold / seats. Overstates the people on board by the no-show rate.
ticket_data.loadSurveyMethod: Manual count of passengers on board at the busiest point of the journey, morning up services only, plus or minus a few percent counting error. Four days out of 365.

both_years.tickets_sold: Tickets sold for the departure. A sale, not a person in a seat.
both_years.sales_closed: True if the operator stopped selling this departure before demand ran out.
both_years.demand_turned_away: Passengers who wanted this departure after sales closed.

2025_only.manual_load_survey: Passengers counted by hand on board, on the four survey days only. The single 2025 field that saw actual people.
2025_only.note: There is no occupancy field for 2025 because no such measurement existed. tickets_sold / seats is an assumed load factor and overstates the people on board by the no-show rate.

2026_only.boarded: People SeatSense saw on board. Tickets sold minus no-shows.
2026_only.seats_occupied: Seats SeatSense measured as physically occupied - the cabin factor numerator.
2026_only.standing: People on board with no seat, measured.
2026_only.ghost_seats: Seats paid for that travelled empty.
